description: Catalog of presentation audiences available in the openpresentation.org catalog. Each entry is a lightweight summary; full audience records (seniority, technical fluency, decision power, attention budget, recommended narratives and tones) live in the per-id JSON files alongside this index. Audiences are referenced from OPF documents via audience. The singular ids from executive onward match the audience pages on pptx.gallery and carry its recommendations; they coexist with the older team-shaped archetypes (executives, investors, customers, and so on), and both sets stay valid.

records.name: Executives
records.summary: Senior leaders who need the recommendation up front, the evidence behind it, and the ask.

records.name: Board of Directors
records.summary: Directors with fiduciary responsibility who balance oversight, advice, and approval.

records.name: Engineering Team
records.summary: Practitioners building the system; they want depth, mechanism, and tradeoffs.

records.name: Investors
records.summary: Capital allocators evaluating fit, traction, and risk-adjusted return.

records.name: Customers
records.summary: Buyers and users — outcome-focused, allergic to jargon, sensitive to time.

records.name: Sales Team
records.summary: Quota-carrying reps who want talk tracks, objection handling, and crisp proof.

records.name: Marketing Team
records.summary: Brand and demand-gen practitioners aligning on positioning, messaging, and campaigns.

records.name: All Hands
records.summary: The full company — mixed roles, mixed seniority, looking for context, signal, and inclusion.

records.name: Candidates
records.summary: Potential hires evaluating company, role, and people.

records.name: Regulators
records.summary: Government, agency, and policy reviewers evaluating compliance, risk, and impact.

records.name: Executive
records.summary: C-suite and senior leadership focused on strategic decisions, ROI, and big-picture outcomes. Highly time-constrained.

records.name: Investor
records.summary: Angel investors, VCs, or institutional investors evaluating financial viability, market opportunity, and team.

records.name: Technical
records.summary: Engineers, data scientists, and technical specialists requiring precision, methodology details, and system-level understanding.

records.name: Sales
records.summary: Sales team or prospective customers focused on product benefits, competitive differentiation, and ROI justification.

records.name: Marketing
records.summary: Marketing professionals analyzing campaign performance, brand metrics, and growth strategies.

records.name: Academic
records.summary: Researchers, professors, and students expecting rigorous methodology, citations, and evidence-based conclusions.

records.name: Internal Team
records.summary: Company employees across functions receiving operational updates, project status, or training content.

records.name: Customer
records.summary: End customers receiving product demos, onboarding presentations, or business reviews.

records.name: General Public
records.summary: Mixed non-expert audience with no assumed domain knowledge.

records.name: Media & Press
records.summary: Journalists, analysts, and media professionals seeking newsworthy insights and quotable statistics.

records.name: Partner / Channel
records.summary: Strategic partners, resellers, or channel organizations needing positioning and enablement content.

records.name: Regulatory / Compliance
records.summary: Government agencies, auditors, or compliance bodies reviewing adherence to rules and standards.
